title: Photo Pop Up
tagline: A new innovative market place for nft Photography. It will create community and exposure simultaneously. This will prevent the same photographers from making sells.
description: There is a huge gap in nft photography between new photographers and experienced photographers. This new marketplace will provide exposure to new photographers and highlight new projects each month in a new location. Very similar to a photography roadtrip. The purpose of this collection is to prevent a staggered marketplace of the same photographers making the sells. It will create an opportunity for new photographers to grow!
how_its_made: This project is fully made on Figma. For future built, Metamask will be used for wallet integration. It will also use Livepeer studios in the future to livestream the art gallery and can create additional exposure for people not living in the pop-up art gallery locations. This can create additional opportunities for the people in the region for jobs in multimedia.
